issue.name: SQL injection
issue.issueBackground: SQL injection is a vulnerability that allows an attacker to interfere with the queries that an application makes to its database.
issue.issueDetail: The application appears to be vulnerable to SQL injection. The parameter id in the URL /api/users?id=1 appears to be vulnerable.

requestresponse.request: GET /api/users?id=1' OR '1'='1 HTTP/1.1 Host: web-server.local User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0

issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') OWASP Top Ten 2021 Category A03:2021 - Injection
issue.remediationBackground: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection.

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Cross-site scripting (XSS) is a type of vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages.
issue.issueDetail: The value of the q parameter is copied into the HTML response.

requestresponse.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html
<html><body>Search results for: <script>alert('XSS')</script></body></html>

issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') OWASP Top Ten 2021 Category A03:2021 - Injection
issue.remediationBackground: Implement input validation and output encoding.

issue.name: Information disclosure - sensitive information in URL
issue.issueBackground: Sensitive information in URLs can be logged or cached.
issue.issueDetail: The URL contains sensitive information (session token) in the query string.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
issue.remediationBackground: Move sensitive information from URLs to request bodies or headers.
